name: VoltCraft Studio — Isolated DC/DC & Magnetics CAD
description: Precision electrical power engineering workbench for Phase-Shifted Full-Bridge (PSFB), LLC Resonant, and Dual-Active Bridge (DAB) isolated DC/DC converters, including iGSE/Dowell high-frequency magnetics, nonlinear Coss ZVS analysis, electro-thermal semiconductor modeling, and small-signal Bode stability.
